exercises.question: Which sentence presents an opinion as asserted? [¿Cuál presenta una opinión como afirmada?]
options: Creo que estudiar en grupo es útil. [I think studying in a group is useful.]
No creo que estudiar en grupo sea útil. [I don't think studying in a group is useful.]
Es posible que estudiar en grupo sea útil. [It is possible that studying in a group is useful.]

exercises.sentence: Creo que este método __ eficaz. [I think this method is effective.] (ser)

exercises.english: I think studying in a group is useful.

sentences: Creo que el método funciona. [I think the method works.]
No creo que funcione. [I don't think it works.]
Es posible que funcione. [It is possible that it works.]

options: Creo que es útil porque permite practicar. [I think it is useful because it allows practice.]
No creo que es útil porque permite practicar. [I don't think it is useful because it allows practice.]
Creo que sea útil porque permite practicar. [I think it be useful because it allows practice.]

exercises.question: Which structure normally follows «No creo que»? [¿Qué estructura sigue normalmente a «No creo que»?]
options: subjunctive [subjuntivo]
future [futuro]
imperative [imperativo]

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly uses «considerar»? [¿Cuál usa correctamente «considerar»?]
options: Considero que este método es eficaz. [I consider this method effective.]
Considero que este método sea eficaz. [I consider this method be effective.]
Considero este método sea eficaz. [I consider this method be effective.]

exercises.sentence: Creo que este método __ útil. [I think this method is useful.] (ser)

template.prompt: State an opinion with the indicative.
template.answer: Creo que estudiar en grupo es útil.

template.prompt: State a rejected or uncertain opinion using the subjunctive.
template.answer: No creo que estudiar solo sea siempre mejor.

options: Creo que es útil, pero no creo que sea perfecto. [I think it is useful, but I don't think it is perfect.]
Creo que sea útil, pero no creo que es perfecto. [I think it be useful, but I don't think it is perfect.]
